title: Large Language Models
summary: Improving the efficiency, stability, and deployability of large-scale language models through research in routing, sparsity, training dynamics, and inference optimization.

title: Robotics and Task Transfer
summary: Studying how learned skills can be reused across tasks, how systems can generalize beyond single trained behaviors, and how to reduce the training data required for each new task.

title: Safe Clinical AI and Medical Research
summary: Researching the safe use of AI systems in healthcare settings, with emphasis on human supervision, reliability, and validated decision support.

title: Energy and Engineering Optimization
summary: Applying optimization and decision support methods to energy systems and engineering problems, focusing on waste reduction, resource efficiency, and design improvement.
